featured_reviews.name: Ali Jooma
featured_reviews.review_text:
Our experience with S&Bella Tours (Bella Tours, India), owned by Sameer, was nothing short of a complete failure. We paid premium prices expecting a high-quality, well-managed Vietnam trip. What we received instead was a poorly planned, poorly executed, and deeply disappointing experience that ruined what should have been a once-in-a-lifetime vacation.

The trip was grossly misrepresented. The “luxury” cruise and accommodations were nowhere near the standard advertised. Conditions were subpar, maintenance was lacking, and the overall environment felt cheap and neglected. This was not a matter of taste or preference — it was a clear gap between what was promised and what was delivered.

Organization was chaotic. Communication was weak. There was no sense of control, professionalism, or ownership from the tour operator. When serious concerns were raised, there was no urgency, no corrective action, and no accountability. It became painfully clear that once payment was collected, customer satisfaction was no longer a priority.

For a company charging top dollar, the level of service was shockingly low. We were left feeling trapped, frustrated, and helpless in a foreign country, relying on a tour operator who failed at even the most basic responsibilities. Instead of enjoying Vietnam, we spent our time managing stress, disappointment, and regret.

What is most disturbing is that this experience could easily mislead other travelers who trust the marketing and promises made by this company. Had we known the reality, we would never have booked through S&Bella Tours under any circumstances.

This was not a luxury experience. It was not even an acceptable one. It was a costly lesson.

Do not be fooled by sales talk or glossy promises. If you value your time, money, and peace of mind, stay far away from S&Bella Tours / Bella Tours. We will be sharing photos and details so others can clearly see what we endured and avoid making the same mistake. Totally TRASH and misleading. FOUND MOSQUITOES IN THE ROOMS AS WELL.
